subject: Request: temporary sandbox credits & trial window due to integration delay
messages:
From: Clark Evans <cevans@finlytics.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox deployment delay — request for trial top-up / extension

Hi Marissa,

Quick update from our side: the FinLytics engineering team hit a blocker during the sandbox deployment. Our internal infra team discovered that our SAML provider is returning unexpected attributes which prevents the app from completing the end-to-end flow.

We were scheduled to validate the Redwood integration this week to finalize the POC, but this means our run-throughs will be pushed out by ~10 business days. With our current trial credits set to expire on 2026-08-14, we’re concerned we won’t have enough time or tokens to complete meaningful testing.

Could Redwood provide a short trial extension or temporary credit top-up so we can finish the validation once the infra issue is cleared? Happy to share logs (attached) and a short timeline. We’d rather avoid restarting the onboarding later.

Attachments: sandbox-deploy-log.txt (text)

Thanks,
Clark Evans
Head of Product
FinLytics
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Clark Evans <cevans@finlytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox deployment delay — request for trial top-up / extension

Clark — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the SAML hiccup.

We can absolutely help so you don't lose momentum. Before I confirm anything, two quick asks: 1) can you share an ETA for when your infra team expects the SAML attributes fixed (approx days), and 2) do you need more token quota or just extra time on the trial window?

Tentatively I can propose a 14-day extension on the trial window AND a 30k token promo credit to cover the initial reruns — pending internal approval. Looping Karthik here to expedite approval.

I’ll follow up shortly with the formal ask.

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval request: 14-day trial extension + 30k token promo for FinLytics (DL-3491)

Karthik / Aditya —

FinLytics (DL-3491) hit an infra/SAML blocker that will delay their sandbox verification by ~10 business days. Rep: Clark Evans. They’ve attached deployment logs.

Proposal: 14-day trial extension + one-time 30k token promo credit (non-renewing) to ensure they can complete validation without restarting the onboarding. Region: US.

Rationale: high likelihood of conversion (PLG motion + integration already completed on product side), time-sensitive — we risk losing momentum if they expire mid-verification. Comparable to previous approvals we gave to FintechPlus (see DL-2978).

Requesting quick approval so I can confirm to the customer. If 30k tokens is too aggressive, open to 20k as fallback.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: 14-day trial extension + 30k token promo for FinLytics (DL-3491)

Marissa — I’m good with this. Approve 14 days + 25k tokens (compromise).

Notes: mark as one-time promo, link to DL-3491 in HubSpot, and set expiration on the credit to 30 days from the extension start so it doesn’t linger. Also ensure CS is aware if they need additional assistance for SAML provisioning.

cc: Aditya for visibility.

Karthik
Director, Sales Operations
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Clark Evans <cevans@finlytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox deployment delay — request for trial top-up / extension

Clark — good news. We approved a 14-day extension to your trial window plus a one-time 25k token promo credit.

What this means:
- Trial window extended from 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-28.
- Promo credit: 25,000 tokens, valid for 30 days from 2026-08-12.
- Credit is non-recurring and tied to DL-3491.

Next steps for you: once your infra team confirms the SAML fix, reply here with the planned test date and we’ll have a member of our integration team on standby to assist. I’ve attached a short summary of our trial policy for visibility.

Attachments: trial_policy_summary.pdf (PDF)

If you need extra tokens after the 25k (e.g., deeper scale testing), let me know and I’ll route an escalation to pricing for a temporary top-up.

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Clark Evans <cevans@finlytics.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox deployment delay — request for trial top-up / extension

Thanks Marissa — that works really well. Our infra lead expects the SAML attributes to be corrected by EOD Friday (2026-08-14). We’ll target the validation run on Monday 2026-08-17 and I’ll confirm here once the fix is deployed. Appreciate the quick turnaround and the standby offer from your integration team.

—Clark
